text: You're racing a punk ass Honda Civic...
But your fuck ass car is too damn slow.
So you immediately floor it. Fuck yes!
Your car doesn't give a fuck. You lose to that dumbass Honda Civic. FUCK!
So you tear all the doors the fuck off your car.
You race him again. This time you blow NOS directly in the damn intake like you're fucking Vin Diesel. Fucking awesome!
But now your bullshit engine fucking explodes. You are not fucking Vin Diesel. Idiot.
So you put a massive supercharged fucking V8 in it. Fucking genius.
But now that sick ass engine is so fucking big you can't see shit. You don't fucking care.
You race that fucking shitbox Civic for the third time. There's so much torque the chassis fucking twists!
You smash into the other car and fly across the fucking continental United States.
Now you're stranded in bumfuck swamp infested Florida.
But you finally beat that dumbass Civic, and that's cool as hell.
